Mia (Marketing): Heads up — we're aiming to drop the release post Tues 5/14 10:00 PT. Need final changelog link + docs URL and a short benchmark blurb for the post. cc @Sam @Jordan :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam (ProdEng): Can confirm canary on Mon 5/13 15:00 PT -> full rollout Tue if no regressions. Bench numbers still stabilizing but seeing ~1.6x throughput after batching changes. Will add a short perf note.

Jordan (Docs): Docs PR is at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/412 — please include the "what's new" bullets I added. Need final changelog snippet (1–2 lines) to push to release notes.

Mia (Marketing): OK — sample blurb: "Reduced per-token latency and 40% cheaper inference for small requests." Is that accurate @Sam?

Sam (ProdEng): Slight tweak: "up to 40% cost improvement for short prompts with batching + KV cache" — avoids hard latency claim. Also add link to benchmark notebook: https://internal.redwood/bench/2024-05-10

Kai (DevRel): For webinar CTA — we have slots Thu 5/16 11:00 PT and Fri 5/17 08:00 PT for customers. Recommend embedding the recording + signup widget in the post and routing registrants to the DevRel queue. @Lena can you confirm inbound handling?

Lena (Growth): Routing plan: HubSpot form -> tag "release-May-24" -> Zap -> HubSpot list -> notify #sales-inbound. We can auto-send the recording to registrants who miss the live too.

Jordan (Docs): Proposed changelog snippet (draft):
```
Improved serving performance: batching + KV cache updates enable up to 40% cost improvements on shorter prompts; see docs & benchmark notebook.
```
Is that okay?

Mia (Marketing): Perfect. Can someone drop the final docs link and the changelog permalink here so I can schedule the post?

Sam (ProdEng): Changelog permalink: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0#performance-updates
Docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.5.0

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary starting 1718923200 (2024-05-13T15:00:00Z) — watchers: @prod-eng, @eng-oncall

Lena (Growth): For inbound flow we'll add UTM params utm_campaign=release_may24 utm_source=blog and a hidden HubSpot field campaign=release_may24 so lists/segments are clean.

Mia (Marketing): I'll schedule the post for Tue 2024-05-14 10:00 PT and include the webinar signup. Thanks team! :rocket:

Kai (DevRel): I'll prep the webinar slide deck with a short demo + bench slide. Ping me if you want to rehearse.

Sam (ProdEng): I'll be on the Wed rehearsal 9am PT.

Jordan (Docs): I'll cut the release notes page once Mia confirms the post content.

Mia (Marketing): Final check: everyone ok with the wording above and links? If no replies by EOD today, we'll proceed.
